name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Après le considérant D - Am 88
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: Da. whereas, pursuant to Article 5(2) TEU, the EU can act only within the limits of the competences conferred upon it by the Member States; whereas housing policy remains primarily within the competence of the Member States and regional and local authorities; whereas any EU involvement in housing must remain supportive and respect the principles of subsidiarity and proportionality; whereas Member States must retain full competence to define eligibility criteria, allocation priorities and safeguards for access to social housing in line with national social, economic and demographic priorities; whereas decisions concerning eligibility criteria, allocation priorities and management structures for social housing fall within the constitutional and administrative autonomy of the Member States and their regional and local authorities;
